workflows.description: Generic workflow for creating or reusing one or more small durable Vontology artefacts after resolving grounded parent/type placement, then reading the represented state back.
workflows.content: Decompose represented-artefact requests into a single artefact or a bounded set. For sets, fan out to the item workflow so each artefact is created or reused and read back independently. For single artefacts, use the direct grounded creation path.

support_concepts.name: Represented Artefact
support_concepts.description: A durable Vontology-represented object created or reused from a user request so Von can refer to it in later workflows.

support_concepts.name: Workflow Coordination Artefact
support_concepts.description: A represented artefact used to coordinate workflow state, reuse labels, progress markers, or future workflow decisions.

support_concepts.name: Workflow Marker
support_concepts.description: A workflow coordination artefact that marks a durable state, checkpoint, skip condition, or completion condition for later workflow runs.

support_concepts.name: Workflow Label
support_concepts.description: A workflow coordination artefact that names a reusable label, category, role marker, or classification used by Von workflows.

support_concepts.name: Research Lab Artefact
support_concepts.description: A represented artefact arising in research-lab work, including coordination records, paper-handling objects, and reusable lab workflow state.

support_concepts.name: Suggestion Provenance Fact
support_concepts.description: A research-lab artefact recording that some source or sender suggested, recommended, or pointed to another represented item.

support_concepts.name: Paper Suggestion Provenance Fact
support_concepts.description: A suggestion provenance fact recording that a sender, email, message, or other source suggested a scholarly paper or work.
